rules: An assessment must reference evidence or an authorized direct observation.
The Operational Event Log stores facts, not grades.
AI can summarize evidence but cannot create missing operational events.
Professional assessment is separate from personal affinity/friendship.
A single event should not dominate long-term career assessment unless its severity justifies it.
Contradictory evidence may coexist and should not be silently averaged into a fictional certainty.
Relevant uncertainty may be preserved in supervisor recommendations.
